message:
Fix deploy email: pre-resolve smtp.gmail.com to IPv4 via dns.lookup

- nodemailer family:4 option was not preventing IPv6 DNS resolution
- Render free has no IPv6; smtp.gmail.com kept resolving to 2607:f8b0:...
- Pre-resolve to IPv4 with dns.lookup({family:4}) then pass raw IP to
  nodemailer with tls.servername for correct SNI handshake

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
